Identified as this saint because: A Menologion of Basil II miniature (Constantinople, c. 985) which Commons titles 'Marcellus, Abbot of Acoemetes' and describes as the 5th-century abbot of the Monastery of the Unsleeping Ones near Constantinople. That is the folder's Marcellus of the Akoimetoi, a 5th-century abbot under the patriarch Gennadius I. Commons describes it: Saint Marcellus (died c. 485–486) was a 5th-century Syrian monk and abbot of the famous Monastery of the Unsleeping Ones (Acoemetes / Accemetarum) near Constantinople  Константинополь. 985 г.
